question: What is the total net sales amount today?
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS TodaySales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS TodayQty, SUM(BillCount) AS TodayBills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
explanation: Today's net sales from primary sales transactions view

question: MTD sales total this month
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS MTDSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS MTDQty, COUNT(DISTINCT XnNo) AS MTDBills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE())
explanation: Month-to-date net sales using year and month filters on XnDt

question: Last 7 days sales
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS Last7dSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Last7dQty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -7, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND CAST(XnDt AS date) < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
explanation: Last 7 days excluding today

question: Last 30 days net sales
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS Last30dSales, SUM(BillCount) AS TotalBills, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS TotalQty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
explanation: Last 30 days rolling sales

question: YTD sales this financial year
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS YTDSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS YTDQty, SUM(BillCount) AS YTDBills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) >= 4 THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 4, 1) ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE())-1, 4, 1) END AND CAST(XnDt AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
explanation: Year-to-date from April 1 of current Indian financial year to today

question: QTD sales this quarter
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS QTDSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (4,5,6) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),4,1) WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (7,8,9) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),7,1) WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) IN (10,11,12) THEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),10,1) ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),1,1) END AND CAST(XnDt AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
explanation: Quarter-to-date using Indian FY quarters (Q1=Apr-Jun, Q2=Jul-Sep, Q3=Oct-Dec, Q4=Jan-Mar)

question: Average bill value this month
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) / NULLIF(SUM(BillCount), 0) AS AvgBillValue, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS TotalSales, SUM(BillCount) AS TotalBills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE())
explanation: Average bill value = total net sales / total bill count

question: Sales this month vs same month last year
sql: SELECT 'This Month' AS Period, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Last Year Same Month' AS Period, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE())-1 AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE())
explanation: Year-on-year comparison for current month using UNION ALL

question: Total returns this month
sql: SELECT SUM(SlrNetAmount) AS TotalReturns, SUM(SlrQty) AS ReturnQty, SUM(SlrNetAmount) / NULLIF(SUM(SlsNetAmount), 0) * 100 AS ReturnPct FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE())
explanation: Sales returns using SlrNetAmount (return amount) and SlrQty (return quantity)

question: Gross margin this month
sql: SELECT SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS Revenue, SUM(NetSlsCostValue) AS COGS, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) - SUM(NetSlsCostValue) AS GrossProfit, (SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) - SUM(NetSlsCostValue)) / NULLIF(SUM(NetSlsNetAmount), 0) * 100 AS GrossMarginPct FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE())
explanation: Gross margin = (Revenue - Cost) / Revenue × 100

question: Top 10 branches by net sales this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 BranchAlias, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(BillCount) AS Bills, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Top branches by net revenue this month

question: Sales by branch today
sql: SELECT BranchAlias, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(BillCount) AS Bills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Today's branch-wise sales

question: Bottom 5 performing branches last month
sql: SELECT TOP 5 BranchAlias, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(BillCount) AS Bills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(DATEADD(month,-1,GETDATE())) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(DATEADD(month,-1,GETDATE())) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY NetSales ASC
explanation: Lowest 5 branches last calendar month

question: Which branches had zero sales today
sql: SELECT b.BranchName, b.ShortName FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_BRANCH_LIST b WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE b.ActiveStatus = 1 AND b.IsWarehouse = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE s.BranchAlias = b.ShortName AND CAST(s.XnDt AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
explanation: Active retail branches with no sales today using NOT EXISTS

question: Branch-wise MTD sales compared to last month
sql: SELECT BranchAlias, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date))=YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date))=MONTH(GETDATE()) THEN NetSlsNetAmount ELSE 0 END) AS CurrentMTD, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date))=YEAR(DATEADD(month,-1,GETDATE())) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date))=MONTH(DATEADD(month,-1,GETDATE())) THEN NetSlsNetAmount ELSE 0 END) AS PrevMonth FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(month,-2,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1)) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY CurrentMTD DESC
explanation: Side-by-side MTD vs previous month using conditional aggregation

question: List all active branches
sql: SELECT BranchId, BranchName, ShortName, City, State FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_BRANCH_LIST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ActiveStatus = 1 ORDER BY BranchName
explanation: All active non-warehouse branches

question: Average daily sales per branch this month
sql: SELECT BranchAlias, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(XnDt AS date)) AS SalesDays, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(XnDt AS date)),0) AS AvgDailySales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY AvgDailySales DESC
explanation: Average daily sales per branch this month

question: Top 10 selling articles by net sales this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 ArticleNo, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty, CategoryShortName FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY ArticleNo, CategoryShortName ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Top 10 articles by net revenue this month

question: Sales by department this month
sql: SELECT DepartmentShortName, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty, SUM(BillCount) AS Bills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY DepartmentShortName ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Department-wise sales breakdown

question: Sales by category this month
sql: SELECT TOP 15 CategoryShortName, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY CategoryShortName ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Category-wise sales this month

question: Top selling fabric types by quantity
sql: SELECT TOP 10 Fabric, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS TotalQty, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND Fabric IS NOT NULL AND Fabric <> '' GROUP BY Fabric ORDER BY TotalQty DESC
explanation: Fabric-wise quantity sold

question: Top 10 products by sales in women's department
sql: SELECT TOP 10 ArticleNo, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DepartmentShortName = 'WOMEN' AND YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY ArticleNo ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Top articles in Women's department this month

question: Color-wise sales breakdown
sql: SELECT TOP 10 Color, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND Color IS NOT NULL AND Color <> '' GROUP BY Color ORDER BY NetSales DESC
explanation: Top colors by net sales

question: Products with highest return rate this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 ArticleNo, SUM(SlsNetAmount) AS GrossSales, SUM(SlrNetAmount) AS Returns, SUM(SlrNetAmount)/NULLIF(SUM(SlsNetAmount),0)*100 AS ReturnPct FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND SlsNetAmount > 0 GROUP BY ArticleNo HAVING SUM(SlsNetAmount) > 0 ORDER BY ReturnPct DESC
explanation: Products with highest return percentage

question: Daily sales trend for last 30 days
sql: SELECT CAST(XnDt AS date) AS SaleDate, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(BillCount) AS Bills, SUM(NetSlsQty) AS Qty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) GROUP BY CAST(XnDt AS date) ORDER BY SaleDate
explanation: Daily sales trend for last 30 days

question: Monthly sales trend last 12 months
sql: SELECT YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) AS Yr, MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) AS Mo, FORMAT(CAST(XnDt AS date), 'MMM yyyy') AS MonthLabel, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, SUM(BillCount) AS Bills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1)) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)), MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)), FORMAT(CAST(XnDt AS date), 'MMM yyyy') ORDER BY Yr, Mo
explanation: Monthly sales trend for the past 12 months ordered chronologically

question: Weekly sales trend last 8 weeks
sql: SELECT DATEPART(year, XnDt) AS Yr, DATEPART(week, XnDt) AS WeekNo, CAST(DATEADD(day, 2-DATEPART(weekday,MIN(XnDt)), CAST(MIN(XnDt) AS date)) AS date) AS WeekStart, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(week, -8, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) GROUP BY DATEPART(year, XnDt), DATEPART(week, XnDt) ORDER BY Yr, WeekNo
explanation: Weekly aggregated sales for last 8 weeks

question: This month daily sales vs same period last year
sql: SELECT CAST(XnDt AS date) AS SaleDate, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, 'CY' AS YearLabel FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY CAST(XnDt AS date) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(XnDt AS date) AS SaleDate, SUM(NetSlsNetAmount) AS NetSales, 'PY' AS YearLabel FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE())-1 AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY CAST(XnDt AS date) ORDER BY SaleDate
explanation: YoY comparison of daily sales for current month

question: Bill count trend last 30 days
sql: SELECT CAST(XnDt AS date) AS SaleDate, SUM(BillCount) AS DailyBills FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) GROUP BY CAST(XnDt AS date) ORDER BY SaleDate
explanation: Daily footfall trend using BillCount

question: Top 10 suppliers by purchase quantity this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 SupplierName, SUM(PurQty) AS TotalPurQty, SUM(PurCost) AS TotalPurCost FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_QTY_WITH_COST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY SupplierName ORDER BY TotalPurQty DESC
explanation: Top suppliers by purchase quantity this month

question: Monthly purchase trend last 6 months
sql: SELECT YEAR(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)) AS Yr, MONTH(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)) AS Mo, FORMAT(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date), 'MMM yyyy') AS MonthLabel, SUM(PurQty) AS PurchaseQty, SUM(PurCost) AS PurchaseCost FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_QTY_WITH_COST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(PurchaseDt AS date) >= DATEADD(month, -6, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),MONTH(GETDATE()),1)) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)), MONTH(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)), FORMAT(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date), 'MMM yyyy') ORDER BY Yr, Mo
explanation: Monthly purchase trend for last 6 months

question: Department-wise purchase this month
sql: SELECT DepartmentShortName, SUM(PurQty) AS PurchaseQty, SUM(PurCost) AS PurchaseCost FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_QTY_WITH_COST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(PurchaseDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY DepartmentShortName ORDER BY PurchaseCost DESC
explanation: Department-wise purchasing this month

question: Purchase returns this month by supplier
sql: SELECT TOP 10 SupplierName, SUM(PrtQty) AS ReturnQty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PRT_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(PurReturnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(PurReturnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY SupplierName ORDER BY ReturnQty DESC
explanation: Supplier-wise purchase returns this month

question: Net purchase value by branch this month
sql: SELECT BranchAlias, SUM(NetPurNetAmount) AS NetPurchase, SUM(NetPurQty) AS NetQty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(XnDt AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY NetPurchase DESC
explanation: Branch-wise net purchase amount after returns

question: Current stock quantity by branch
sql: SELECT BranchAlias, SUM(StockQty) AS TotalStock, COUNT(DISTINCT ArticleNo) AS UniqueArticles FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY BranchAlias ORDER BY TotalStock DESC
explanation: Current stock levels by branch

question: Stock by category
sql: SELECT CategoryShortName, SUM(StockQty) AS TotalStock, SUM(StockQty * ItemMRP) AS StockMRPValue FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY CategoryShortName ORDER BY TotalStock DESC
explanation: Stock quantity and MRP value by category

question: Articles with zero stock
sql: SELECT TOP 50 i.ArticleNo, i.Description, i.InvCategoryShortName, i.InvDepartmentShortName FROM dbo.VwMstItems i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.VwAIStockData s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE s.ItemId = i.ItemId AND s.StockQty > 0)
explanation: Articles that have zero stock across all branches

question: Total stock value at MRP by department
sql: SELECT DepartmentShortName, SUM(StockQty) AS TotalQty, SUM(StockQty * ItemMRP) AS StockValueAtMRP FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY DepartmentShortName ORDER BY StockValueAtMRP DESC
explanation: Department-wise stock value at MRP

question: Stock ageing — articles purchased more than 90 days ago still in stock
sql: SELECT TOP 50 ArticleNo, BranchAlias, CategoryShortName, SupplierName, SUM(StockQty) AS StockQty, MIN(PurInvoiceDt) AS OldestPurchase, DATEDIFF(day, MIN(PurInvoiceDt), GETDATE()) AS DaysInStock FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE StockQty > 0 AND CAST(PurInvoiceDt AS date) <= DATEADD(day, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) GROUP BY ArticleNo, BranchAlias, CategoryShortName, SupplierName ORDER BY DaysInStock DESC
explanation: Slow-moving stock purchased 90+ days ago

question: Goods in transit by branch
sql: SELECT TargetBranchAlias AS DestBranch, SUM(GitQty) AS GITQty, SUM(GitCostValue) AS GITCostValue FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_CBS_WITH_GIT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE GitQty > 0 GROUP BY TargetBranchAlias ORDER BY GITQty DESC
explanation: Goods currently in transit to each branch

question: How many unique customers purchased this month
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS UniqueCustomers FROM dbo.VwAICustomerDetails WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(CreatedOn AS date)) <= YEAR(GETDATE()) AND ActiveStatus = 1
explanation: Unique customer count — uses VwAICustomerDetails. Note: for transaction-based customer count use VwAISalesData if available.

question: Top 10 customers by sales value
sql: SELECT TOP 10 c.CustomerFirstName + ' ' + c.CustomerLastName AS CustomerName, c.ContactMobile, SUM(s.MrpValue) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.XnNo) AS TotalInvoices FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT s WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.VwAICustomerDetails c WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE CAST(s.[XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST(s.[XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY c.CustomerFirstName, c.CustomerLastName, c.ContactMobile ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
explanation: Top customers by MrpValue this month — joins VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT with VwAICustomerDetails on CustomerId

question: Customers with birthday this month
sql: SELECT CustomerFirstName + ' ' + CustomerLastName AS Name, ContactMobile, ContactEmail, BranchName, MONTH(BirthdayDt) AS BirthMonth, DAY(BirthdayDt) AS BirthDay FROM dbo.VwAICustomerDetails WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MONTH(BirthdayDt) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND ActiveStatus = 1 ORDER BY DAY(BirthdayDt)
explanation: Customers with birthday this month. Filter by MONTH only — never by YEAR for birthdays.

question: New customers registered this month
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NewCustomers FROM dbo.VwAICustomerDetails WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE YEAR(CAST(CreatedOn AS date)) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(CAST(CreatedOn AS date)) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND ActiveStatus = 1
explanation: New customer registrations this month using CreatedOn date

question: Customer group-wise sales this month
sql: SELECT c.CustomerGroupName, SUM(s.[MrpValue]) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.CustomerId) AS Customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.[XnNo]) AS Invoices FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT s WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.VwAICustomerDetails c WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE CAST(s.[XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST(s.[XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY c.CustomerGroupName ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
explanation: Sales by loyalty tier / customer group — uses MrpValue on VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT joined with VwAICustomerDetails

question: Customers with anniversary this month
sql: SELECT CustomerFirstName + ' ' + CustomerLastName AS Name, ContactMobile, BranchName, DAY(AnniversaryDt) AS AnnivDay FROM dbo.VwAICustomerDetails WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MONTH(AnniversaryDt) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND AnniversaryDt IS NOT NULL AND ActiveStatus = 1 ORDER BY DAY(AnniversaryDt)
explanation: Customers with wedding anniversary this month

question: Top 10 suppliers by gross revenue this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 [SupplierName] AS Supplier, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales, SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty, COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY [SupplierName] ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
explanation: Top suppliers/salespersons ranked by gross revenue this month using VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT

question: Supplier sell-through rate this month
sql: SELECT TOP 20 a.[SupplierName] AS Supplier, SUM(a.[MrpValue]) AS SalesValue, SUM(p.[MrpValue]) AS PurchaseValue, SUM(a.[MrpValue]) / NULLIF(SUM(p.[MrpValue]), 0) * 100 AS SellThroughPct FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT a WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_REPORT p WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.[SupplierName] = p.[SupplierName] AND CAST(p.[XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) WHERE CAST(a.[XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST(a.[XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY a.[SupplierName] ORDER BY SellThroughPct DESC
explanation: Supplier sell-through = MrpValue sales / MrpValue purchase

question: Salesperson performance this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 [SupplierName] AS Salesperson, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT [XnNo]) AS BillCount, SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY [SupplierName] ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
explanation: Top salespersons by gross revenue this month — SupplierName column is salesperson, no JOIN needed

question: Supplier-wise category mix this month
sql: SELECT TOP 20 [SupplierName] AS Supplier, [CategoryShortName] AS Category, SUM([MrpValue]) AS TotalSales, SUM([AppQty]) AS TotalQty FROM dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([XnDt] AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST([XnDt] AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) GROUP BY [SupplierName], [CategoryShortName] ORDER BY [SupplierName], TotalSales DESC
explanation: Which categories each supplier sells in — uses VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT with MrpValue
